invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Pre-invoices and invoices made by hand, numbered and frozen once made. A mistake is fixed by cancelling the invoice and making a new one.
invoices.needsBillingDetails: Add your billing details first: the firm's name, address and state go on every invoice.
invoices.superAdminsOnly: Only a super admin sees invoices: they are money.
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. Make the first with New invoice.
invoices.billingDetailsLoadFailed: The billing details didn't load, so New invoice and Copy are off for now.

invoiceForm.createDescription: Fill in who it is for and what it charges. Once made, an invoice never changes.
invoiceForm.copyDescription: Everything is copied but the date and the number, and it is made as an invoice. Change what you need.
invoiceForm.billToStateHint: Needed to charge GST: it decides CGST and SGST or IGST.
invoiceForm.linesHint: Each rate is for one, before GST. The amount is the quantity times the rate.
invoiceForm.gstNeedsGstin: Add your GSTIN in Billing details to charge GST.

problems.quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999.
problems.rateInvalid: Enter a rate in rupees, more than zero, so that quantity times rate stays under ₹10 crore.
problems.stateNeededForGst: Choose the billed company's state to charge GST.

cancelInvoice.title: Cancel invoice {number}?
cancelInvoice.description: It stays in the list marked cancelled, and its number is not used again. To correct it, make a new invoice.

billingDetails.title: Billing details
billingDetails.intro: The firm that sends the invoices. Entered once; an invoice keeps the details it was made with, so a later change only affects new ones.
billingDetails.superAdminsOnly: Only a super admin can see and change billing details.
billingDetails.gstinHint: Only a GST-registered firm may charge GST. Until one is saved, invoices have no GST.
billingDetails.signIntro: Printed on every new invoice: the logo beside the firm's name, the signature above the signatory's name. PNG or JPEG, at most 1 MB each. Optional.
billingDetails.uploaded: Ready. It is saved when you save the details.

imageProblems.type: Choose a PNG or JPEG image.
imageProblems.size: This file is over 1 MB. Choose a smaller one.
imageProblems.upload: The upload didn't work. Try again.

billingDetails.signatoryTitleHint: For example Proprietor. Printed under the name.
billingDetails.defaultTermsHint: Fills the notes of every new invoice; each invoice can change it.
billingDetails.prefixHint: Up to 8 capital letters, digits or dashes, such as INV.
